implementation: search_pcb_models: opt-in core API builds a baseline and each explicit search-policy strategy once from the same hardware inputs, retaining the best complete screened model. Default board generation is unchanged.
invariants: Strategy overrides cannot change circuits, contracts, caller shape/face restrictions or outline specification.
Independent placement gates, enforced compose results, fanout, off-board checks and finite ranking values screen each constructed candidate.
Ranking is area, width, height, cross-wire length. Wiring length is a tie-break, not an acceptance ceiling. Exact ties retain the incumbent.
Typed construction infeasibility is recorded; other exceptions propagate. Missing/unrepresentable receipts cannot become an apparently complete aggregate.
Each attempt retains its actual construction/screening accounting. The returned aggregate, not the selected model's subset, owns portfolio work.
The caller input-preparation prefix is owned once, including when the baseline fails before floorplan preparation.
No historical model loading, implicit extra strategies, publication, or gate waivers.

new_real_devkit_cases: injected challenger construction failure retains byte-identical baseline PCB
independent observed primitive calls match complete portfolio receipt
per-attempt sum equals aggregate including fallback sequence
unexpected challenger exception propagates with completed baseline and failed prefix
identical candidate does not replace incumbent
caller prefix counted once on success and early failure
overflow marks receipt unavailable rather than publishing a partial total

remaining_integration: API is exercised by actual-model tests but not yet invoked by the CLI/profiler optimisation workflow. Add explicit bounded strategy selection there, preserve aggregate accounting at downstream import boundaries, and test a natural expanded-catalog carrier regression. Screening does not replace full electrical, source, DRC, thermal, assembly or rendering qualification.
limits: No smaller carrier, new qualified board, performance claim, Python comparison, or complete suite run. Existing output files are untouched. This is the core incumbent-retention implementation, not completion of the overall search integration or long-running goal.
